note: RAB3A-associated ataxia manifests with progressive cerebellar ataxia, while neurodevelopmental features are explicitly described as variable and contributing to intrafamilial phenotypic heterogeneity.

evidence.text: Affected individuals with heterozygous RAB3A p.Arg83Trp variants presented with adult-onset cerebellar symptoms, whereas neurodevelopmental disorders and features were variable and contributed to intrafamilial phenotypic heterogeneity.

source.title: An R83W mutation in Rab3A causes autosomal-dominant cerebellar ataxia
source.quote: Variable features of neurodevelopmental disorders were also observed.
